dogecoin.text: Rather than asking "What problem did Dogecoin solve?" as CNET does in the article @kdrum cites we should be asking what is going on in our economy/financial systems that cryptocurrencies are drawing in "investment". Instead of trying to understand cryptocurrencies, we should be..

@kdrum has an interesting post on Dogecoin, calling it the canary in the coal mine. He notes it has apprecaited 22,624% in the past year. He notes Dogecoin is a "cautionary tale" as is the "entire cryptocurrency space." But I feel we are asking the wrong question...
